title: FileItem
description: One manifest entry of a SessionRequest (UML FileItem 5.0). Mirrors packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/file_item.dart. A 0-byte file has chunkCount 0. `sha256` is lowercase hex, or null for files larger than 2 GiB (the sender then supplies it in the POST .../complete body). Unknown members MUST be ignored.

fileId.description: Sender-assigned identifier, unique within the session (e.g. f1).

fileName.description: Display file name. Receivers MUST sanitize it before touching the file system (LSP-1 section 5).

relativePath.description: Folder-relative path using `/` separators; null for single files. Folders are a stretch feature.

sha256.description: Whole-file SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex chars, or null when not known at manifest time (files > 2 GiB).

modified.description: Last-modified time, ISO-8601 UTC, or null.
